newsitem.title: USA: Nutrition Medical offers diabetic formula.
newsitem.headline: Nutrition Medical offers diabetic formula.

text.p: Nutrition Medical Inc said Thursday it is launching a ready-to-use nutrition formula for people with hyperglycemia and diabetes, the company's first disease-specific nutritional formula.
The company said it plans to market Gluco-Pro to long-term care facilities, home health care dealers and directly to home patients.
Nutrition Medical develops and markets more than 50 clinical nutrition products for hospitals and nursing homes and private-label adult nutrition supplements which are sold through retail chains.
